items.exampleEn: The two brothers had a mock fight with pillows.
items.exampleZh: 兩兄弟拿枕頭假裝打了一架。

items.exampleEn: It was just a harmless joke, and everyone laughed.
items.exampleZh: 那只是個無傷大雅的玩笑，大家都笑了。

items.exampleEn: She was rightly proud of her first book.
items.exampleZh: 她以自己的第一本書為榮，這是理所當然的。

items.exampleEn: Add the rice when the water is boiling.
A foul smell was coming from the fridge.
items.exampleZh: 冰箱裡傳出一股難聞的味道。

items.exampleEn: The search for the missing cat was unsuccessful.
items.exampleZh: 尋找走失的貓沒有結果。

items.exampleEn: Shouting at the dog was ineffective; it kept barking.
items.exampleZh: 對那隻狗大吼沒有用，牠還是一直叫。

items.exampleEn: He has coarse, dark hair like his father.
items.exampleZh: 他跟爸爸一樣，頭髮又粗又黑。

items.sentenceEn: It's boiling outside today, so take a bottle of water with you.
items.sentenceZh: 今天外面熱得要命，帶一瓶水在身上吧。

items.audioEn: Our school held mock interviews so students could practice before applying for real jobs.
items.audioZh: 我們學校舉辦模擬面試，讓學生在應徵真正的工作之前先練習。
items.questionZh: 學校為什麼舉辦模擬面試？
options: To find jobs for every student this week

items.sentenceEn: The fans rightly cheered for the young goalkeeper after the game.
items.sentenceZh: 比賽結束後，球迷為那位年輕守門員歡呼，這是他應得的。

items.sentenceEn: This brown bread is made from coarse flour.
items.sentenceZh: 這種黑麵包是用粗麵粉做的。

items.stemEn: After two ____ attempts, he finally passed his driving test.
items.stemZh: 失敗兩次之後，他終於通過了駕照考試。

items.stemEn: The cheap umbrella was completely ____ against the strong wind.
items.stemZh: 那把便宜的傘遇到強風完全沒有用。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, my family went camping in the hills. We had practiced in our garden with a mock tent made of old sheets, but putting up the tent still took three tries. We persisted and finally got it right. That night, we cooked rice on a small stove and told stories. The bug spray we brought was ineffective, so the insects bit us all night. In the morning, my brother screamed when he saw a snake near the tent, but our guide said it was harmless, and soon it moved away. Around noon, the weather turned foul, with strong wind and heavy rain. Our guide rightly decided that we should walk back early, and we reached the car just before the storm got even worse.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們全家去山上露營。我們事先在院子裡用舊床單搭了一頂假帳篷練習過，但帳篷還是試了三次才搭好。我們沒有放棄，最後終於搭好了。那天晚上，我們用小爐子煮飯、講故事。我們帶去的防蚊液沒有效，蟲子咬了我們一整晚。早上，我弟弟看到帳篷旁邊有一條蛇，嚇得尖叫，但嚮導說那條蛇無害，沒多久牠就自己離開了。中午左右，天氣變得很惡劣，颳起強風、下起大雨。嚮導決定我們應該提早走回去，這個決定很正確；我們在暴風雨變得更猛烈之前就回到了車上。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼大家整晚被蟲咬？
options: 他們把晚餐的剩菜留在帳篷外面
帶去的防蚊液沒有效果

questions.questionZh: 嚮導為什麼決定提早走回去？
options: 帶去的食物和水都沒了

items.promptZh: 這條舊毛巾摸起來很粗糙。
referenceEn: This old towel feels very coarse.
This old towel is coarse to the touch.
rubricZh: coarse 的用法，例如 feels coarse、coarse to the touch 等
時態合理（例如 feels、is 等）

items.promptZh: 她第一次開店失敗了，但她沒有放棄。
referenceEn: Her first attempt to open a shop was unsuccessful, but she didn't give up.
She was unsuccessful the first time she opened a shop, but she did not give up.
rubricZh: unsuccessful 可放 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 was unsuccessful、an unsuccessful attempt 等）
「沒有放棄」可寫，例如 didn't give up、kept trying 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 was、didn't、hasn't given up 等）
